symptomShortText: Low lap shear strength on S22 brackets bonded with DISPENSER1 - off-ratio adhesive mix from worn metering pump

causesIshikawa.description: Bonding operator changed cartridges per DOC-8815 Rev B
WC-BOND-02-DISPENSER1 hardener metering pump worn - mix ratio 1.32:1 vs 1.00:1 +/-2%, adhesive under-cured
Cure profile 60 min at 80C unchanged since 8D-10048745
Adhesive lot AD-3317 within shelf life and certificate
Pull tester PT-05 verified with reference load cell
Cell humidity 38% RH, inside the 45% maximum

fiveWhyChain.question: Why did the S22 brackets fail the pull test?
fiveWhyChain.answer: Lap shear strength measured 5.2 MPa against a 12.0 MPa minimum on parts bonded with DISPENSER1

fiveWhyChain.question: Why was the bond weak only on DISPENSER1 parts?
fiveWhyChain.answer: DISPENSER1 mixed resin and hardener at 1.32:1 instead of 1:1, so the adhesive never fully cured

fiveWhyChain.question: Why did DISPENSER1 mix off-ratio? (root cause)
fiveWhyChain.answer: The hardener metering pump was worn and the mix ratio was never checked at cartridge change

actions.actionText: Block all S22 brackets from batch B-52640 and pull-test a sample from every pallet
Replace the worn hardener metering pump assembly on WC-BOND-02-DISPENSER1 and verify the 1:1 mix ratio
Add a mix ratio check by weight at every cartridge change to the bonding cell checklist on all dispensers

fmeaLink.description: Under-cured bond from off-ratio adhesive mix

lessonsLearned.whatWorked: Splitting pull-test results by dispenser isolated DISPENSER1 within a shift
lessonsLearned.whatDidnt: Mix ratio was trusted to the machine - nobody weighed a shot after cartridge changes

isIsNot.isWhereWhenItHappens: S22 bond line - WC-BOND-02-DISPENSER1 - batch B-52640, May 2026
isIsNot.isNotWhereWhenItDoesnt: WC-BOND-02-DISPENSER2 - same adhesive lot AD-3317 and same cure profile
isIsNot.notes: Defect follows the dispenser, not the adhesive lot or humidity
